CFLAGS="-O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer" && \
SRC="SAX.c entities.c encoding.c error.c parserInternals.c parser.c tree.c hash.c list.c xmlIO.c xmlmemory.c uri.c valid.c xlink.c HTMLparser.c HTMLtree.c debugXML.c xpath.c xpointer.c xinclude.c nanohttp.c nanoftp.c catalog.c globals.c threads.c c14n.c xmlstring.c buf.c xmlregexp.c xmlschemas.c xmlschemastypes.c xmlunicode.c xmlreader.c relaxng.c dict.c SAX2.c xmlwriter.c legacy.c chvalid.c pattern.c xmlsave.c xmlmodule.c schematron.c xzlib.c" && \
